previous_assumption: No formal order/work-order document existed after a Commercial Quotation was awarded — the Rental record itself was treated as the whole of the finalized agreement, with no separate printable/auditable document.
correction: Business validated a formal Work Order is required. Implemented as a new entity auto-created inside CommercialQuotationService.awardQuotation immediately after the Rental is created — never a standalone 'create' route, so it can never be hand-entered or diverge from what was actually awarded. Snapshots every negotiated term plus a copy of the quotation's scope items (stays stable even if the source quotation were later altered). Lifecycle issued->completed|cancelled, deliberately NOT auto-cascaded from Rental's own status changes yet (flagged as a Phase 2/infra candidate). Printable document is a server-rendered, print-styled HTML endpoint (browser print-to-PDF is the deliverable) — no PDF library dependency added. CommercialQuotationService depends on a narrow WorkOrderCreationPort (one method), not the concrete WorkOrderService — unlike the documented RentalService exception (reused for real business logic/validation), Work Order creation here is a plain snapshot-and-store, so the ordinary port-based convention applies instead. Bug found and fixed during verification: the printable document's display-info resolution was reused from the in-app view (which only resolves machine/product/project for the Renter side) — the Rental Company's own printed copy came back blank until fixed to always resolve full detail for both parties.
